# ataila_whoami (Data Source)

Who the provider is acting as: the principal behind the token, how it authenticated, what it may do right now and when its credential expires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_whoami" "me" {}

output "acting_as" {
  value = "${data.ataila_whoami.me.principal.name} (${data.ataila_whoami.me.auth_kind})"
}

output "token_expires_at" {
  value = data.ataila_whoami.me.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `auth_kind` (String) How the caller authenticated: `pat` (personal token), `service_account` or `session`.
- `expires_at` (String) When the credential expires (RFC 3339), when the platform reports it.
- `principal` (Attributes) The calling principal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--principal))
- `scopes` (List of String) Effective permission keys: for a token, the scopes it was minted with that the principal still holds right now.
- `token` (Attributes) The API token in use; null for a portal session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token))

<a id="nestedatt--principal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `principal`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) E-mail address; a service account has a synthetic one.
- `id` (String) User id.
- `kind` (String) `human` or `service`.
- `name` (String) Display name.


<a id="nestedatt--token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token`

Read-Only:

- `allow_destroy` (Boolean) Whether the token was minted with destroy allowed.
- `granted_scopes` (List of String) Scopes the token was minted with.
- `id` (String) Token id.
- `name` (String) Token name.
- `prefix` (String) The token's public prefix, as the portal shows it.
